name: Jordan Reeves
description: 18-year-old school leaver needing NI number, provisional licence, and first job setup — brand new to government services

jordan.qualification: A-levels: Business Studies (B), Media Studies (C), English Language (C)
jordan.notes: Just finished sixth form at Bulwell Academy. No work experience beyond part-time at Greggs during year 13. Wants to get into digital marketing or social media.

financials.notes: Youth current account with Monzo. Birthday and Christmas money. Living with mum — no rent. Household income is mum's salary.

family.notes: Lives with mum Karen Reeves (46, admin at Queen's Medical Centre). Parents separated — dad in Derby, occasional contact. Younger sister Mia (14) also at home.

housing.notes: Council tenancy in mum's name. Jordan has lived here since birth.

communicationStyle.tone: Informal, direct, slightly impatient. Uses slang occasionally. Not rude — just young and doesn't know how government works. Expects things to be as easy as signing up for an app.
communicationStyle.techSavvy: High — lives on phone. Uses apps for everything. Has never filled in a government form. Doesn't know what a National Insurance number is or why it matters.
primaryConcerns: Getting an NI number so he can start work
Understanding what he needs to do now he's 18
Not having to go to an office or fill in paper forms
typicalPhrases: I've just turned 18 and I need to sort some stuff out
Do I need a National Insurance number? How do I get one?
Can I do all this on my phone?
My mum said I need to get this sorted before I can get a job
How long does this take? I've got an interview next week

logins.notes: Eighteen and brand new to government — no Government Gateway, no GOV.UK One Login. Will have to create everything from scratch, starting with an NI number.
